lines.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!
Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.
Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?
Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.
Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?
Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!
Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.
Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?
Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.
Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?
Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.
Thank you both so very much.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng lín. Polite hospitality word paired with 欢迎 in 欢迎光临 ('Welcome!').

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

examples.text: 欢迎光临我们的院子咖啡馆！
examples.trans: Welcome to our courtyard café!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū niang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个姑娘 ('a young woman').

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 台阶上放着一个用白纸包着的小木盒。
examples.trans: A small wooden box wrapped in white paper was sitting on the steps.

examples.text: 哪怕只有一个客人入住，我们也会准备好热腾腾的早饭。
examples.trans: Even if only one guest checks in, we still prepare a piping hot breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng. Family name of Teacher Song (宋老师).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 这栋百年老宅如今登记在他们兄弟俩名下。
examples.trans: This century-old house is now registered under the names of the two brothers.

examples.text: 祖父退休前把这家小客栈转到了孙女名下。
examples.trans: Before retiring, Grandfather transferred this little guesthouse into his granddaughter's name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yù dìng. Works as both verb and noun at hotels/restaurants.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老师 ('a teacher').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē. Measure word (量词): 列 (liè), e.g. 一列火车 ('a train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: lèi. Describes physical fatigue after travel or work.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？

examples.text: 坐了一上午火车，您一定累了吧？

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè xie. Standard expression of gratitude; takes an optional person after it (谢谢您).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú guò. Gentle conversational 'though / however', softer than 但是.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个行李箱 ('a suitcase').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天一天 ('all day today').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。

meanings.note: Pinyin: tè bié. Very common intensifier before adjectives/verbs ('especially'), or adjective ('special').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòng. Describes heavy luggage, heavy tools, or serious matters.

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子里面 ('inside the suitcase').

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí yǒu. Combines 只 ('only') with 有 ('have / there is').

meanings.note: Pinyin: qún zi. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条裙子 ('a skirt / dress').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè pǔ. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本乐谱 ('a book of sheet music').

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǐ huan. Everyday verb for liking food, rooms, or people.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!
